description: This source file defines the internal class 'DynamoDBMembershipTable' which implements the 'IMembershipTable' interface for managing membership data using Amazon DynamoDB within an Orleans clustering setup. It includes methods for initializing the table, reading, inserting, updating, and deleting silo membership entries, along with logic for handling concurrency and consistency. The class also contains detailed logging through partially defined logger message attributes.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements the Orleans IMembershipTable interface for DynamoDB backend, managing silo membership data including reading, writing, updating, deleting, and initializing membership records, with detailed logging and concurrency control.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes DynamoDB table and creates initial version record if specified.

methods.name: TryCreateTableVersionEntryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to create the version record in DynamoDB if it does not already exist.

methods.name: TryCreateTableVersionRecord
methods.description: Prepares a new version record with specified version and etag.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries associated with a specific cluster ID.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads membership data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all silo membership entries along with version verification.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry with concurrency control through conditional expressions.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership record, with optimistic concurrency via etag.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a specific silo.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts MembershipEntry and TableVersion into a DynamoDB record.

methods.name: ConvertPartial
methods.description: Converts a MembershipEntry into a partial DynamoDB record for IAmAlive updates.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silo entries that are considered defunct based on IAmAlive timestamp.
